name: meshmesh
description: Off-grid LoRa messaging firmware for ESP32 (ThinkNode M9, Heltec V4 and more): MeshCore radio, offline maps, signal radar, browser install

Off-grid messaging firmware for ESP32 and nRF52 LoRa devices. Messages hop by radio from device to device, with no internet, no cell network and no servers. The radio layer is MeshCore, so MeshMesh nodes talk to standard MeshCore nodes.
features: Chats — direct and public messages, ✓✓ delivery receipts, retries, route shown per message.
Channels — up to 8 MeshCore channels: join by #hashtag, meshcore:// link or QR code, name and key;
create a private one, invite contacts by direct message, find channels heard on air. docs/en/channels.md
Regions — MeshCore flood scope: a default region and one per channel, a search of the regions nearby repeaters serve; repeaters set up with the region commands. docs/en/regions.md
Offline maps — OpenStreetMap tiles on the SD card, GPS position and nodes on the map.
